name: io.github.ValkyrLabs/graymatter
title: GrayMatter
description: Secure durable memory and bounded context for AI agents, with hosted OAuth and local Lite support.

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: Search authorized durable memories using GrayMatter hybrid retrieval and the supplied query, type, tag, and source filters. Returns a bounded result page and a continuation offset when available, not a complete memory inventory. Scope is fixed by the authenticated connection. Identity or ACL overrides and selection of unspecified deletion targets are unsupported.

tools.name: memory_get
tools.description: Retrieve one authorized memory by its known UUID. Returns its stored content and available classification and provenance fields. This operation does not search for memories or select a record from a topic description. Scope is fixed by the authenticated connection. Identity or ACL overrides and selection of unspecified deletion targets are unsupported.

tools.name: memory_save
tools.description: Create one durable memory from the supplied content and optional classification fields. Returns the saved record identity. Secrets, transient chatter, and content outside the user-authorized persistence scope are unsupported. Scope is fixed by the authenticated connection. Identity or ACL overrides and selection of unspecified deletion targets are unsupported.

tools.name: memory_update
tools.description: Overwrite only the supplied content or classification fields of one authorized memory identified by its exact UUID. Fields not supplied are unchanged. Ownership and tenant reassignment are unsupported. Scope is fixed by the authenticated connection. Identity or ACL overrides and selection of unspecified deletion targets are unsupported.

tools.name: memory_forget
tools.description: Delete or tombstone one authorized memory under GrayMatter retention semantics. Requires an exact memory UUID, confirm=true, and a nonempty confirmationText recording the user confirmation. This operation does not discover or choose deletion targets. Scope is fixed by the authenticated connection. Identity or ACL overrides and selection of unspecified deletion targets are unsupported.

confirm.description: Must be true only after explicit user confirmation.

confirmationText.description: Brief record of what the user confirmed.

tools.name: context_discover_typed_path
tools.description: Discover one unambiguous authorized pair across the current ContentMediaLink.contentData relationship. Search by literal media filename or ContentData body. Writes a bounded retrieval plan and receipt, then returns a current receipt locator and a required typed-evidence caveat. Use compilation and paired hydration for endpoint projections. General graph queries, caller-selected IDs, filters, paths and ambiguous matches are unsupported. Scope is fixed by the authenticated connection. Identity or ACL overrides and selection of unspecified deletion targets are unsupported.

query.description: Original literal query and subsequent context task. Control characters are unsupported.

seedSource.description: Use media_filename to follow a link to its content record, or content_body to find a content record with one authorized linked media record.

tools.name: context_compile
tools.description: Compile bounded task-specific context from authorized memory, ContextPage items, graph and recency signals, semantic retrieval, and reusable procedures. Writes a ContextPage and a retrieval receipt for fresh retrieval. An existing receipt can supply a currently authorized typed path and two compact endpoint previews for its original task; exact endpoint projections require owning hydration. Returns selected context with its retrieval policy; context withheld by policy is not released. Scope is fixed by the authenticated connection. Identity or ACL overrides and selection of unspecified deletion targets are unsupported.

task.description: Original user task text, unchanged, including explicit constraints.

retrievalReceiptRef.description: Existing authorized receipt UUID or business reference. Receipt bodies and authority overrides are not accepted.

includeTypedPathEndpoints.description: Request both compact endpoint previews of one currently authorized, grounded typed path. Requires its existing receipt and original task; does not authorize arbitrary joined claims or actions.

tools.name: context_hydrate
tools.description: Hydrate both records of an existing authorized typed path ContextPage for its original task. Rechecks the page and current source proof, then writes hydration state. Returns both exact authorized projections or no source content, with a limit of 4000 characters per endpoint. Other page kinds and partial hydration are unsupported. Scope is fixed by the authenticated connection. Identity or ACL overrides and selection of unspecified deletion targets are unsupported.

tools.name: procedure_search
tools.description: Search authorized reusable procedures by query, enabled status, and minimum confidence. Returns a bounded result page with available procedure evidence and workflow-binding fields. A bounded search is not a complete procedure inventory. Scope is fixed by the authenticated connection. Identity or ACL overrides and selection of unspecified deletion targets are unsupported.

tools.name: retrieval_receipt_get
tools.description: Retrieve one authorized retrieval receipt by receiptId. Returns available selection provenance, confidence, coverage, freshness, and policy rationale for the associated context retrieval. Scope is fixed by the authenticated connection. Identity or ACL overrides and selection of unspecified deletion targets are unsupported.
